source: Solomatov, G. and Akkaynak, D., 'Spectral Sensitivity Estimation Without a Camera', arXiv:2304.11549 (2023), CC BY 4.0: the colour matrices their method starts from (data/color-matrices in https://github.com/COLOR-Lab-Eilat/Spectral-sensitivity-estimation; the paper describes them as the colorimetric mapping matrices of the Adobe DNG Converter). 'A' = ColorMatrix for CIE illuminant A (tungsten, 2856 K), 'D65' = for daylight D65; XYZ -> camera, DNG convention. Converted to this file unchanged; camera names are the file names with '-' read as spaces.
